id: HT-TG-01 (test mode needs the test-stage marker: with STORE_TEST_MODE=1 in the environment and no marker in the plugin copy, every STORE_TEST_* switch is ignored and named once on stderr)
note: Review of 0.1.17 (pre-existing): STORE_TEST_MODE=1 alone turned every test switch on in a normal run; STORE_TEST_NOW let prune list and delete young evidence and stopped handoff citations protecting files, STORE_TEST_OS and STORE_TEST_CYGDRIVE changed path reading. helper/lib/testgate.pm now needs STORE_TEST_MODE=1 and the marker .store-test-stage at the root of the plugin copy the helper runs from (only the test stagers write it; tools/gates test-stage fails a plugin that holds one). This case runs a staged copy without the marker ("test_stage": false), with the same STORE_TEST_* environment the runner gives every case.

steps.name: STORE_TEST_NOW does not move prune's age cut-off without the marker: the unit written today is not listed

stderr_has: ^prune: test switches ignored \(not a test stage\): .*STORE_TEST_MODE, .*STORE_TEST_NOW

steps.name: STORE_TEST_OS=msys with STORE_TEST_CYGDRIVE does not change path reading without the marker: a drive-form entry is not an absolute path

stdout_has: ^prune_protected_roots entry C:\\x: not an absolute path
